groups.mergedClaim: The recovery CLI does not specify an immutable binding to the inspected attempt, allowing a delayed or repeated recovery invocation to apply an old operator assertion to a newer uncertain attempt.
A bootstrap whose confirmed created pane becomes unavailable before downstream completion has no terminal abandonment path and can indefinitely block archival of its selected existing thread.

The design does not specify how to reconcile a downstream-complete but bootstrap-incomplete crash when caller or topology guards become invalid before retry, potentially stranding the live outer fence.
